criteria.requirement: A selectable three-floor, four-rooms-per-floor 3D building and charts use the same bundled seven-day hourly sample dataset with stable room IDs, areas and units.
criteria.action: Inspect floors, room details and the complete available date range.
criteria.expected: Three floors each contain four rooms with stable IDs, areas, units and seven days of hourly sample data shared by model and charts.

criteria.requirement: Daytime meeting rooms, continuous server load, a discoverable overnight office spike and a distinct missing-reading interval are represented.
criteria.action: Inspect meeting-room, server-room, spike-room and missing-data charts.
criteria.expected: Daytime use, continuous load, an overnight office spike and a missing interval are distinct; the initial interval exposes the spike.

criteria.requirement: User-selectable total-energy versus per-area coloring has a labeled scale that stays constant while hiding floors; missing data is distinct from zero.
criteria.action: Switch total/per-area coloring and hide a floor; compare missing and zero readings.
criteria.expected: Units and legend agree with the chosen metric, hiding floors preserves the scale, and missing readings differ from zero.

criteria.requirement: Incomplete totals are marked partial with available/expected reading counts.
criteria.action: Select a time range containing missing readings and inspect totals.
criteria.expected: Incomplete totals are identified as partial and show available versus expected reading counts.

criteria.requirement: Room selection is synchronized between 3D, sortable table, hourly chart and summary; hiding the selected floor clears the selection consistently.
criteria.action: Select a room in 3D and the sortable table, then hide its floor.
criteria.expected: Outline, table, chart and summary agree on the room; hiding its floor clears the selection everywhere.

criteria.requirement: Time/floor filters and comparison of two rooms on a shared chart update consistent readings.
criteria.action: Change time and floor filters, then compare two rooms.
criteria.expected: Filtered data and the two-room shared chart remain synchronized with the model.

criteria.requirement: Filtered CSV summaries download with units and completeness represented.
criteria.action: Download the filtered room-summary CSV and inspect it.
criteria.expected: Exported rows match the current filters and include units and data completeness.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial spike, sample-data label, building rooms, legend and missing data.
Select from the table and building, change metric/time/floor filters and compare two rooms.
Hide a selected floor, compare legend endpoints before/after, inspect a partial interval and download the filtered CSV.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
